title: Password reset link expires immediately after email is sent
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in AuthGate, the user encountered: Password reset link expires immediately after email is sent.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Forgot password?
2. Observe UI state: Check your email
3. Observe UI state: Link expired

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Link expired.

## Environment
- App: AuthGate
- Platform: web
